name: Preferences
author: Vestra Player
punchline: Open the options window, change the palette and the language
description: Options… (F5) in the context menu opens the player's options window. Its Appearance page picks the palette (Vestra Dark, Vestra Light) with previews; its Language page picks the interface language, used from the next start. Both are also in the command palette (Appearance: …, Language: …).
